title: The Dice Pit
text: Devils crowd around a pit, howling, throwing dice for the souls of whole Houses. Coins and teeth change hands. A great bone die tumbles down the slope as you watch, and one of them points at you and laughs: it has just rolled yours.

options.label: Let the devils' throw land where it will. You could not stop it if you tried.

outcomes.text: The House wins. The devils howl, paying in coin they cannot spend in hell.
The House loses. Its Scions feel something leave them, which the devils pass around, cheering.

options.label: The shrewdest cheats the devils at their own game, and dares them to notice.

outcomes.text: Loaded dice beat loaded dice. The devils are almost proud.
No one knows cheating better than devils. The whole pit turns on you.

options.label: Run before the dice stop rolling, and pray they forget your House.

outcomes.text: They do not chase. They will roll again later, when you are not there to see.
